entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Periods of heavy rain, and amounts may approach warning criteria, mainly about the ranges. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Snow Watch
entry.summary: Periods of heavy snow developing in Otago late afternoon and in the Mackenzie Basin from evening. Snowfall amounts may approach warning criteria above 600 metres, with lesser amount down to 400 metres. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Moderate.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Heavy Rain Watch
entry.summary: Heavy rain is expected to spread north this morning and afternoon, and amounts may approach warning criteria. Chance of upgrading to a Warning: Low. Changes: The chance of upgrade for this Watch has been decreased to Low.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected to lower to 500 metres from late afternoon or evening. 3 to 6 cm of snow may accumulate above 700 metres, with lesser amounts lower down to 500 metres. The heaviest falls are likely between 6pm and 9pm today.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow may affect the road this afternoon and evening. About 1 to 3 cm of snow may accumulate at the tunnel's east entrance, with lesser amounts down to 700 metres.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected to develop above 900 metres early Thursday morning. 1 cm or less of snow may accumulate about the summit.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected to lower to 600 metres overnight. 1 to 4 cm of snow may accumulate about the summit, with lesser amounts down to 600 metres.

author.name: Meteorological Service of New Zealand Limited

entry.title: Road Snowfall Warning
entry.summary: Snow is expected to lower to 600 metres this evening, possibly down to 400 metres briefly. 4 to 8 cm of snow may accumulate above 600 metres, with lesser amounts down to 400 metres.
